paragraphs: MyVolunteer is a volunteer management platform covering recruitment, scheduling, tracking, and reporting. Onboarding runs on customizable forms and automated processes, and the platform tracks volunteer hours and generates reports on impact and performance. Volunteers themselves get a self-service portal for managing their schedules, hours, and profiles.

In healthcare the platform is aimed at hospitals, clinics, and healthcare organizations, and handles background checks, ongoing criminal monitoring, and certification tracking. The K-12 school version manages parent volunteers, classroom aides, and event helpers, and checks that individuals meet background check requirements. Government agencies are named as a third market, with screening and volunteer tracking set against federal, state, and local regulations.

The product was developed by background screening experts and integrates with a background and criminal monitoring platform. The about page names nonprofits, schools, healthcare providers, and government agencies as the organizations the company works with.

quote.text: Streamline recruitment, scheduling, tracking, and reporting with MyVolunteer.
